text:
sara: quick heads-up — trying to onboard gptx-3-small-prod into eval-harness, CI is failing the synthetic prompt checks

sara: runner is returning weird sample duplication on the synthetic cohort, looks like >90% repeats

bijan: ugh, seen that before when the sampler seed wasn't getting passed through the new task wrapper

sara: yeah i pulled logs, looks like the PromptSet meta tags are getting stripped during tokenization step (we use them later for holdout sampling)

mike: logs: ```
2025-11-03T12:03:14Z ERROR runner.sample_batch IndexError: pop from empty list
  File \"/srv/eval/runner.py\", line 241, in sample_batch
    idx = available.pop()
IndexError: pop from empty list
```

alyssa: could that be because the tokenization changed token counts and downstream code expects original lengths? saw similar with quantized tokenizers

bijan: also our sampler relies on prompt metadata field `cohort_id` being present. If tokenizer returns only `text` we lose grouping and fallback sampler degenerates to uniform sampling -> duplicates

alyssa: @sara can you paste a minimal repro (PromptSet JSON + runner config) so i can add a CI regression test?

sara: pasted below (trimmed): ```json
{\"prompts\": [{\"id\": \"p1\", \"cohort_id\":\"A\",\"text\":\"Summarize the doc.\"}, {\"id\":\"p2\", \"cohort_id\":\"B\",\"text\":\"Extract dates.\"}], \"tokenizer\":\"gptx-tokenizer-v2\"}```

mike: the harness/runner change that landed yesterday replaced `deep_merge` on prompt metadata with a shallow copy in an attempt to lower mem usage — that would cause nested attrs like `meta.cohort` to be lost

eval-bot: CI job 6421 failed: eval-harness/synthetic-sampling (see https://ci.redwood/internal/6421) :red_circle:

bijan: fix approach: restore deep copy for prompt metadata OR change sampler to use flattened `cohort_id` at top-level. I prefer changing sampler to be defensive if metadata missing.

alyssa: agree — make sampler resilient + add unit that simulates tokenization stripping metadata and assert sampling still preserves holdout ratios. i'll add the test to the eval-harness matrix.

sara: i'll open a tiny PR to runner that (1) restores deep copy for now, (2) adds a small synthetic fixture showing the tokenization-stripped case, and (3) wires the CI to run the fixture on PRs against new model bring-ups

mike: also annotate the model onboarding checklist: \"verify promptset metadata survives tokenization/serialization\". add an automated lint that checks PromptSet schemas for required fields before onboarding completes.

bijan: one more: metric noise earlier — when duplicates occur, our coverage metric inflated. once sampler fix lands we should rerun the gptx-3-small eval to see if the quality/regression numbers change.

alyssa: +1. i'll add a dashboard panel showing sample-unique-rate over time for each model so we can catch this earlier.

sara: thanks all — i'll ping when PR is up. short-term mitigation: disabling the new shallow-merge util in runner until tests land.

mike: 👍
